title: I could have got him promoted there to be the manager
html_source: Molly thinks that she could have saved Mr. Bloom’s job by trading a sexual favor with Mr. Cuffe but Mr. Bloom stopped her by being obstinate. This is interesting – Mr. Bloom doesn’t seem to mind Molly’s affair when it is for her needs but won’t allow Molly to have sexual relations for his benefit.
